manifest.notes: The Firm (NOTSTOCK) launch paired with IMD. LpDesk(token, operator = dev wallet 0x8ad18e99f4c8d8406f9ba8899cf308000518a981 as fixed by the brief, project wallet = 0x3c587eff6c96eacf7e3dcc2cff6416161386e48c, the fixed project wallet the brief names, written literally because it is a payout recipient with no privileged power) creates Burner in its constructor; its modules PriceGuard, LpGovernor, VenueV3 and VenueV4 are not deployed by the launch but afterwards by anyone through LpDesk.deployModule(kind, code) with code hashes fixed in LpDesk. FirmVault(project wallet = 0x3c587eff6c96eacf7e3dcc2cff6416161386e48c, LpDesk) receives the pool's 1% fee share once the project wallet calls the factory's setRequester(launchNumber, FirmVault); distribute(token) is open to anyone and buyback is restricted to LpDesk's operator. GenesisSplitter(LpDesk, dev wallet) split() sends 50/60 of its NOTSTOCK to LpDesk and 10/60 to the dev wallet once. No contract has an owner, pause, upgrade or mint. Not manifest fields, set in the launch request: poolBps 3000 and remainderTo = 0x3c587eff6c96eacf7e3dcc2cff6416161386e48c, which then transfers 600,000,000 NOTSTOCK to GenesisSplitter; the paying wallet must be the project wallet so it can call setRequester.
